hypothesis: The calibrated spatial-ecology framework (null models, rarefied descriptors, graph pruning) produces consistent, correctly-calibrated results when applied end-to-end to an independent spatial dataset, not only GSE300147.
unit_of_analysis: dataset (the independent spatial dataset as a whole)
exclusion_criteria: None pre-specified; dataset selection criteria are recorded in governance/validation_plan.tsv (`16_external_validation_and_generalisation/00_define_validation_claims.py`) before this analysis runs.
primary_endpoint: Qualitative + quantitative reproduction of calibration guarantees (Type I error, power) established in Spatial Graph Construction and Calibration on the new dataset.

hypothesis: Clonal spatial/phenotypic descriptor variance decomposes into identity, context, and patient components with non-trivial, estimable magnitude for each -- not that spatial context is the only or dominant source.
unit_of_analysis: clone, nested in patient and section
exclusion_criteria: Clones excluded per TCR Clonal Analysis release (low-confidence/ambiguous calls); patients excluded per Quality Control release.
primary_endpoint: Posterior/estimated variance-component magnitudes (identity, context, patient) with patient-level uncertainty, on the frozen taxonomy_version from External Checkpoint Validation.

hypothesis: Clone ecological structure is better described by a continuous latent axis than by discrete categorical clusters (prespecified as the null to beat).
unit_of_analysis: clone, nested in patient and section
primary_endpoint: Model comparison statistic (BIC / gap statistic / continuity metric) between discrete and continuous structure models.
multiplicity_family: primary (Q2), gates whether a taxonomy is reported at all

hypothesis: Fibroblast/myeloid barrier topology (path/resistance distance to tumour) explains residual variance in clone-tumour engagement beyond cell-intrinsic state and niche composition alone.
unit_of_analysis: clone, nested in patient and section
exclusion_criteria: Same as q2_variance_partition_confirmatory; additionally requires a calibrated degree-preserving null (`09_spatial_graph_construction_and_calibration/08_run_calibration_suite_on_synthetic_data.py`) to have passed for the barrier-graph null model specifically.
primary_endpoint: Effect size of barrier topology on engagement after adjusting for state and niche composition, with patient-level uncertainty.
taxonomy_version: uses frozen taxonomy_version from External Checkpoint Validation

hypothesis: This project's barrier-topology effect sizes are quantitatively comparable in direction and/or magnitude to Grout/Kim 2022 (lung CAF exclusion) and Hwang et al. 2022 (pancreatic multicellular communities) -- stated as a comparison, not a directional hypothesis to be 'confirmed'.
exclusion_criteria: n/a -- literature comparison, not a new statistical test on this project's own data.
primary_endpoint: Qualitative and, where the published studies report comparable effect-size statistics, quantitative concordance.

hypothesis: RESERVED SLOT -- the single (or, capped, second) pre-specified HPV contrast for the entire thesis, to be named by scripts/15_hpv_stratified_analysis/01_prespecify_primary_hpv_contrasts.py before any HPV test is run. This registry entry exists to enforce the cap: no second confirmatory HPV analysis_id may be added without removing or explicitly justifying exceeding the 1-2 limit recorded in this file.
exclusion_criteria: Per Quality Control release; HPV status source is p16_ihc_status, cross-validated against Xenium HPV16-E5 probe signal in `15_hpv_stratified_analysis/00_validate_hpv_metadata_and_probe_signal.py`.
primary_endpoint: To be fixed by `15_hpv_stratified_analysis/01_prespecify_primary_hpv_contrasts.py` before this analysis runs, alongside its prospective minimum-detectable-effect-size simulation (`15_hpv_stratified_analysis/02_run_prospective_power_simulation.R`).

hypothesis: Each spatial null model (constrained permutation, degree-preserving, graph-preserving) achieves nominal Type I error and adequate power on synthetic data with known ground truth, at n=10-patient scale, before being trusted on real clones.
primary_endpoint: Empirical Type I error rate at nominal alpha; power curve across a range of simulated effect sizes.
multiplicity_family: methods validation, gates all downstream spatial-association claims (Phases 10-14)

hypothesis: Off-patient probes, non-T cells, and spatially permuted controls establish an empirical false-positive rate for clone calls, used to set detection thresholds -- not a directional biological hypothesis.
unit_of_analysis: cell (for the false-positive-rate estimate itself); clone (downstream use)
primary_endpoint: Empirical false-positive rate per patient/probe, and the detection threshold it implies.
multiplicity_family: methods validation, gates all downstream clone-level claims (Phases 11-15)

hypothesis: Technical replicate sections (day nested within patient, 7/10 patients) show concordant counts, cell composition, expression, and spatial statistics -- explicitly expected to reproduce the source paper's own finding that 1 of 7 pairs does not.
exclusion_criteria: n/a -- this analysis itself informs later exclusion decisions.
primary_endpoint: Concordance statistics per replicate pair; explicit flag for the pair expected to be discordant.

hypothesis: Confirmatory clone-tumour engagement results (q3_barrier_topology_confirmatory and the engagement component of q2_variance_partition_confirmatory) are not artefacts of the primary segmentation, and are robust to an independently resegmented reference subset.
unit_of_analysis: clone, on the `04_quality_control/05_resegment_reference_subset.py` resegmented reference subset
exclusion_criteria: Restricted to sections included in the `04_quality_control/05_resegment_reference_subset.py` resegmented subset only.
primary_endpoint: Direction and approximate magnitude concordance between primary and resegmented-subset estimates for the same effect.
multiplicity_family: robustness check on q2/q3, not independently multiplicity-corrected
taxonomy_version: uses frozen taxonomy_version from External Checkpoint Validation

hypothesis: The provisional (Clone Spatial Descriptors) clone-structure signatures project onto an independent public HNSCC reference with the same direction of effect, not necessarily the same magnitude or statistical significance.
exclusion_criteria: Per whatever independent reference is selected in `12_external_checkpoint_validation/00_project_provisional_signatures_to_bulk_reference.py`; recorded there, not pre-specified here.
primary_endpoint: Directional concordance (sign agreement), not p<0.05, per this checkpoint's own design.
multiplicity_family: gate for taxonomy freeze/revise decision, not a multiplicity-corrected confirmatory test
taxonomy_version: tests v1 (provisional), decides whether it becomes frozen
